theorems.name: no_illicit_certification
theorems.statement: Certificate issuance requires ProofObject + GovernanceGate + ReverseTrace.

theorems.name: monotonicity_boundaries
theorems.statement: No certainty rise is allowed without matching valid evidence.

theorems.name: residual_persistence
theorems.statement: Residuals must be emitted and cannot be silently erased.

theorems.name: forbidden_escalation
theorems.statement: Forbidden transitions must block certificate escalation and preserve downgrade visibility.

theorems.name: triad_closure
theorems.statement: Public final judgments are closed to zero/hypothesis/certificate only.

theorems.name: replay_integrity
theorems.statement: Replay and forensic reconstruction must remain reproducible from immutable event history.
